title: Observe real enqueue admission in the existing pending signal store

remediation_summary.gap_diagnosis: Root38167902596 owner evaluation warned queue_lag_ms absent (observed: null) and bridge degraded. In original DecisionSignalProducer through both memory and RedisPendingSignalStore, store.enqueue serialized no enqueue observation (missing enqueued_at) while PaperRuntimeService._handle_order_event already consumed enqueued_at to measure queue lag. Signal generation timestamp was preserved as generation time but not recorded as queue admission time.
remediation_summary.adapter_fix: In pending_signal_store.py, _observed_enqueue_payload records genuine queue admission UTC time as enqueued_at upon physical store enqueue across InMemoryPendingSignalStore and RedisPendingSignalStore without trusting caller-supplied timestamps or duplicating metadata writers. Caller input dictionary and nested metadata are preserved without in-place mutation via json deep copy. Existing exact-payload requeues (via nack_requeue or reclaim) retain the initial enqueue observation without calling enqueue or resetting observation.
remediation_summary.bridge_preservation: Existing approved failclosed bridge truth from PR6490 and PR6491 is preserved without alteration. Unverified, conflicting, or uninstalled bridge paths remain truthful explicit None/degraded without inventing synthetic repo/commit identity.

test_signal_producer.detail: Verified DecisionSignalProducer produce to memory and Redis serialization records real enqueue interval observation while preserving caller input and batch signals without manual enqueue metadata; verified conflicting forged caller timestamps are rejected and actual enqueue operation interval is observed while caller input and correlation fields are preserved.

test_signal_consumer.detail: Verified SignalConsumer validation, duplicate filtering, conflict resolution, staleness, DLQ routing, and claim heartbeat/fencing.

test_paper_runtime.detail: Verified end-to-end real store -> SignalConsumer -> PaperRuntimeService measured queue_lag_ms in service snapshot and heartbeat telemetry event, retained negative tests for missing, invalid, and future timestamps (staying None/degraded without fabricated zero metric).

test_signal_isolation.detail: Verified disposable real Redis 7 container drill: enqueue, claim, nack requeue, visibility recovery across crashed workers, and duplicate-signal fence proof retain exact payload, correlation envelope, and initial enqueue observation.
